questions.q: Which feature helps rainforest trees survive on thin soils?
questions.why: Buttress roots give support to tall trees with shallow roots.

questions.q: Which is an adaptation of a cactus to drought?
questions.why: Shallow, wide roots soak up light rain before it evaporates.

questions.q: Why does soil erosion increase after deforestation?
options: Roots no longer bind the soil and rain hits bare ground
Trees add water to the soil
questions.why: With no roots or canopy, heavy rain washes the topsoil away.

questions.q: Explain one way the rainforest can be managed sustainably.
questions.model: Selective logging: only mature trees are cut and the rest left, so the forest can regrow and keep providing timber, habitats and carbon storage in future.
points: a valid strategy (selective logging, replanting, reserves, ecotourism)
explanation of how it protects the forest for the future
